head: fc3e34c5f6115b55751874df21c3a9286bd09a5e
claim: The listener gate required exactly one file-backed Assembly-CSharp.dll mapping in /proc/<pid>/maps. Unity 2019.4 never produces one, so the invariant was unsatisfiable by construction and no staged candidate could ever pass it.

how_observed.method: bounded non-gameplay probe; starts display and jar, completes the agent handshake that spawns the player, reads /proc/<pid>/{exe,cwd,maps} for the port owner, tears down. Loads no level and fires no shot.

mechanism: Mono mmaps class-library assemblies as file-backed mappings. Unity loads the user assembly Assembly-CSharp.dll through its own loader, so it is never a file-backed mapping and cannot appear in the map table.

first_live_failure.error: port listener owner pid=675476 has 0 mapped Assembly-CSharp.dll images

diagnosis: gate defect, not candidate defect. The measurement distinguishes the two: the owning process's exe and cwd both resolve inside the verified clone, and nine of its file-backed mappings come from that clone, so it is the staged code. Only the required anchor was wrong.

correction_applied.why: it is mapped file-backed from the candidate root, it is the native code that actually owns the socket, and it carries a digest in provenance.json
correction_applied.assembly_still_pinned_by: digest read through the listener's own root view at /proc/<pid>/root/<root>/9001_Data/Managed/Assembly-CSharp.dll, plus device and inode observed at that path
correction_applied.identity_chain_after: socket inode -> pid -> exe/cwd -> mapped UnityPlayer.so device+inode+digest -> provenance UnityPlayer.so digest -> assembly device+inode+digest via process root -> provenance assembly digest -> provenance bytes digest -> staged archive digest -> launched process tree
correction_applied.deviation_from_mission_wording: The mission text names 'mapped Assembly-CSharp.dll' as a binding input. That exact binding is not obtainable from this runtime. The substitute anchor is strictly obtainable and no weaker: it adds a mapped-code digest that the original chain never had, and retains the assembly digest. This deviation is deliberate and is flagged rather than silently taken.
